summary: The session focuses on the importance of trust in data governance and its implications for AI and analytics. It discusses the need for organizations to adopt a trust model that enhances decision-making and operational efficiency. The speaker emphasizes the role of governance as an enabler for innovation and collaboration in data-driven environments.

sections.topic: Introduction to Trust in Data Governance
key_points: Trust is essential for effective data governance and decision-making.
Organizations face challenges in adopting new practices and technologies.
Data governance should be viewed as an enabler rather than a control mechanism.
Different types of data require varying levels of trust and governance.
Establishing a trust model involves assessing data quality and lineage.
Feedback mechanisms are crucial for continuous improvement in data governance.

sections.topic: Impact of Trust on Business Outcomes
key_points: Companies using trust models see improved compliance and financial performance.
Effective storytelling is essential for communicating the value of data governance.
Determining who decides on trust levels can be complex.
Governance should involve collaboration across the organization.
Trust is foundational for the development of autonomous AI.
A hybrid trust model can reduce risks associated with AI outputs.

key_takeaways: Establish a trust model to enhance data governance and decision-making.
Incorporate feedback mechanisms to continuously improve data quality.
Communicate the value of trust in data governance through effective storytelling.
